BiblicalUsage: One verse: in the parable of the wedding feast in Matthew 22:5, the invited guests made light of the king's invitation and went their ways, one to his farm, another to his merchandise.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe business is a poor excuse for missing a king's feast, and I never want my work to be the reason I turn down God's invitation.
